title: Virtual Drug Reversal
primary_question: Which small-molecule perturbations are predicted to reverse the conserved MS3 high-risk transcriptional architecture?

frozen_queries.Q2: Independent G2M + Mitotic Entry + Spindle/Chromosome programs

primary_interpretation: A subset of globally convergent drug perturbations retained directional reversal of the frozen MS3 Core50 and independent mitotic programs in HEPG2.
secondary_interpretation: Differentiated/metabolic restoration was weaker and heterogeneous and does not establish complete MS6-like restoration.
integrated_Step33_35_claim: The MS3 proliferative/mitotic architecture shows convergent predicted vulnerability to both virtual regulator suppression and transcriptomic drug perturbation.
claim_boundary: In silico transcriptomic reversal only; not therapeutic efficacy, clinical benefit, experimental drug sensitivity, or causal state reprogramming.
